Oven Baked Pot Roast
By: Anonymous
Published: Wednesday, December 23, 2009 - 11:15pm

Ingredients




4 pounds chuck roast
4 med. potatoes, cut into quarters
4 carrots, cut into quarters
1 lg. stalk celery, cut into pieces
1 env. dry onion soup mix

Preparation

1 Place pot roast in baking dish or casserole with cover. Sprinkle onion soup mix over meat. Cover; bake at 350 degrees for 2 to 2 1/2 hours. Add potatoes, carrots, and celery; cover and continue baking for 1 hour. 2 Makes 6-8 servings.
